format_reference.note: Pins the reference inspected during M1.1 verification; it does not prove which revision the earlier moving-master lookup used.

cases.cpp_behavior: Scans on four-byte steps for 0x28211407 and requires at least 512 bytes remaining.
16-bit wrapping byte sum from offset 10 through binary_size.
Rejects overlap with the binary header and complete six-entry v1 or counted v2 table list.
cases.compatibility_behavior: Does not add strict overlap checks.
cases.strict_behavior: Requires the IP Discovery table to start after the complete applicable header and table-list region (six entries for v1, num_tables entries for v2).

cases.cpp_behavior: Rejects a die header inside the fixed IP Discovery header.
cases.compatibility_behavior: Does not add strict overlap checks.
cases.strict_behavior: Requires the entire four-byte die header to start after the fixed 80-byte IP Discovery header and fit inside the table.

cases.cpp_behavior: Uses table list offset 12 below major version 2 and 16 for major version 2 or above.
cases.strict_behavior: Accepts versions 0, 1, and 2; validates the version-2 table count.

cases.cpp_behavior: Does not validate the IP_DISCOVERY table checksum.
cases.compatibility_behavior: Does not validate the table checksum.
cases.strict_behavior: Validates the checksum over the declared IP Discovery table bytes.

cases.cpp_behavior: Bounds the table by the declared binary and each requested record by the declared table; validation remains lazy.
cases.compatibility_behavior: Retains the previously verified full-input-buffer behavior and therefore differs from the current C++ parser.
cases.strict_behavior: Validates table and all record extents inside declared binary/table boundaries.

cases.cpp_behavior: Requires a nonzero die count and reads the first die only.
Does not inspect the IP Discovery version or v4 64-bit-base flag.
cases.strict_behavior: Accepts IP Discovery versions 1 through 4 with 32-bit bases; rejects unknown versions and v4 64-bit bases.

cases.cpp_behavior: Returns at most 16 bases and advances by the full declared count.
cases.strict_behavior: Rejects records declaring more than 16 bases.

cases.cpp_behavior: Validates a record only when ipAt is requested.
cases.compatibility_behavior: Validates records lazily and returns no entry if a read fails.

cases.cpp_behavior: Calculates the byte offset using 32-bit unsigned arithmetic.
cases.strict_behavior: Returns no value when the result exceeds the 32-bit range.

limitations: The C++ bounds regressions use synthetic fixtures; they do not establish RX 7600 format compatibility.
Python compatibility mode preserves the earlier C++ behavior and intentionally no longer matches the newly bounded C++ parser for declared-table overlaps and truncated records.
The pinned commit identifies the Linux header inspected during M1.1 verification; it does not establish the revision fetched in the earlier moving-master lookup.
Strict mode rejects IP Discovery v4 data using 64-bit base addresses.
